query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('observed_at',clock_timestamp(),'max_connections',current_setting('max_connections'),'roles',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',rolname,'connection_limit',rolconnlimit,'settings',rolconfig)) FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN('supabase_storage_admin','authenticator','authenticated','supabase_realtime_admin')),'connections_now',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('application',application_name,'state',state,'wait_type',wait_event_type,'n',n)) FROM(SELECT application_name,state,wait_event_type,count(*) n FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid<>pg_backend_pid() AND backend_type='client backend' GROUP BY 1,2,3)x),'blocked_now',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE cardinality(pg_blocking_pids(pid))>0)) AS evidence
